issues.description: The UML in the problem statement specifies getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor() returns int, but the template's TODO comment explicitly states the return type should be double for precise calculation and the provided solution implements getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor() returning double. This inconsistency leaves students unsure which return type to implement and may cause signature/compilation/test mismatches.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the return type consistent across all artifacts. Preferably update the UML in problem_statement.md to show getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor(): double (to match the template comment and solution), and update any descriptive text or tests accordingly. Alternatively, change the template comment and solution to use int if integer division is intended.
